scripts.build: pnpm --filter @accessibility-devkit/core build && pnpm --filter @accessibility-devkit/cli build && pnpm --filter="./packages/*" --filter="!@accessibility-devkit/core" --filter="!@accessibility-devkit/cli" --parallel build
scripts.spelling: cspell --config cspell.json README.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs/*.md examples/*.md packages/*/README.md python/README.md skills/accessibility/references/*.md
scripts.test:consumers: node tests/consumers/esm.mjs && node tests/consumers/commonjs.cjs && tsc --noEmit -p tests/consumers/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm spelling && pnpm test:docs && pnpm test:manifests && pnpm test:packages && pnpm test:python && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm test:consumers
scripts.release: pnpm test && pnpm test:pack && changeset publish
